EmailTemplate.subject: Are you a finance leader losing 4-5% in revenue per month?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
In a recent survey of finance leaders in mid-market businesses, 55% say they lose 4-5% in revenue per month due to inefficiencies in their payment processing. Businesses expect to get paid quickly and securely but that is not the reality. ‌
The amount lost is between 6-10% of revenues for 23% of those surveyed. These costs include high wire fees, processing fees and various opaque banking fees.
